company_profile.summary: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd is India's largest pharmaceutical company and the fourth largest specialty generic pharma company globally. Operating across specialty dermatology, ophthalmology, onco-dermatology, and branded formulations, Sun Pharma sells medicines in over 100 countries with manufacturing across six continents.

revenue_breakup.desc: Patented biologics and specialty formulations in dermatology, ophthalmology, and onco-dermatology.
Prescription therapies across cardiology, psychiatry, neurology, gastroenterology, and diabetology.
Complex generics, injectables, controlled substances, and oral solids.
Branded generics in Russia, Brazil, South Africa, and Southeast Asia.
Bulk drug manufacturing and regulated market regulatory filings.

company_profile.geographic_mix: United States: 38% • India: 32% • Emerging Markets: 18% • Western Europe & RoW: 12%
moats_and_strengths: #1 pharmaceutical company in India with over 8.3% domestic market share and unmatched doctor prescription equity.
Patented global specialty pipeline generating over $1.0B in annual revenue, shielding the business from generic price erosion.
43 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants worldwide compliant with US FDA, EMA, and PMDA approvals.
Robust balance sheet with net cash position exceeding $1.5 billion powering strategic acquisitions.
company_profile.order_book_or_capacity: R&D Spend: ~6% of annual revenues ($350M+) • 43 manufacturing sites • Global Specialty revenue > $1.0B

bullish_triggers: Deuruxolitinib (Leqselvi) launch for severe alopecia areata representing a potential multi-hundred-million blockbuster.
Sustained double-digit growth in Indian chronic therapy formulations (cardiology, neurology).
Operating leverage expansion as global specialty sales outpace fixed marketing expenditures.
bearish_risks: Regulatory scrutiny or Form 483 inspection observations from the US FDA at key formulation facilities.
Generic price erosion in standard commodity oral solid dosage forms in North America.
